```sql
SELECT (last.milliseconds * 100.0) / (champ.milliseconds + last.milliseconds) AS faster_percentage
FROM races r
JOIN results champ
  ON champ.raceId = r.raceId
 AND champ.positionOrder = 1
JOIN results last
  ON last.raceId = r.raceId
 AND last.time IS NOT NULL
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND last.positionOrder = (
        SELECT MAX(r2.positionOrder)
        FROM results r2
        WHERE r2.raceId = r.raceId
          AND r2.time IS NOT NULL
  );
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE goal_events(match_id, home_team_api_id, rest, event) AS (
    SELECT m.id, m.home_team_api_id, m.goal, NULL
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.goal IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ge.match_id,
           ge.home_team_api_id,
           substr(ge.rest, instr(ge.rest, '</value>') + 8),
           substr(ge.rest, instr(ge.rest, '<value>') + 7,
                  instr(ge.rest, '</value>') - instr(ge.rest, '<value>') - 7)
    FROM goal_events ge
    WHERE ge.rest LIKE '%<value>%</value>%'
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM goal_events ge
JOIN Player p ON p.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'
WHERE ge.event IS NOT NULL
  AND ge.event LIKE '%<player1>%</player1>%'
  AND ge.event LIKE '%<team>%</team>%'
  AND CAST(substr(ge.event, instr(ge.event, '<player1>') + 9,
                  instr(ge.event, '</player1>') - instr(ge.event, '<player1>') - 9) AS INTEGER) = p.player_api_id
  AND CAST(substr(ge.event, instr(ge.event, '<team>') + 6,
                  instr(ge.event, '</team>') - instr(ge.event, '<team>') - 6) AS INTEGER) = ge.home_team_api_id;
```
